title: Git-transport recutover has no exit path for a stale covered row
wanted_capability: A supported ceremony path out of CoverageStalePendingRecutover. Once a covered repo's catalog membership_generation moves past its marker row (for example after promoting subtree projects), typed history activation is superseded pending a newer cutover and provenance import refuses, so the readiness evidence a new cutover requires (Committed activation journal at the current ready source, per-member provenance receipts, code HEAD matching typed history) can never be produced: the freeze forbids exactly the publications the evidence needs. Cutover apply only replaces Proposed rows and carries every other predecessor row forward verbatim, so a stale row can never leave the marker, and the resolution artifact only acknowledges blocked, never-covered repos. Wanted: a ceremony verb or resolution arm that drops or re-baselines a stale covered row without forging evidence, or a freeze exception that admits the publications a recutover needs.
missing_primitive: Ceremony verb or resolution arm that drops or re-baselines a stale covered row
fallback_used: Offline retirement of the whole cutover marker and receipt with backups, returning every repo to Uncovered-with-grant, which the activation gate admits.
evidence: crates/bbox-indexing/src/git_transport_cutover.rs::capture_granted_repo (refuses without typed history parity, matching code HEAD, overlay, provenance receipt)
src/server/history_activation.rs::finish_activation (supersedes: a newer cutover must authorize publication)
